verdict.rationale: Self-hosting the core product is a fair question for a terminal coding agent, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows that ByteAsk can drive self-hosted or bring-your-own-key models, which is an adjacent capability. The product itself depends on ByteAsk's hosted account sign-in, plans and usage credit, and nothing documents a self-hostable deployment of the core service.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
